title: TI P4-09: apply the copy, convert bodies to Markus, fidelity check against the baseline
description:
## Goal
Apply the copy to the new backend, convert bodies to Markus, and prove the new site equals the baseline. This is the fidelity gate.

## Context (FACT)
- convert-bodies writes bodyMarkus and bodyIr only when the derived IR reproduces the original paragraphs exactly, otherwise records a skip reason; Pretext on develop reads bodyIr (PPY-cddfb8), so every published article needs bodyIr before the site renders it.
- Pull quotes today are a separate string list; PPY-b794e1 (open) plans positional :::pull-quote directives for Papyrus and TI content. NOT part of this ticket: convert-bodies keeps pull quotes as they are; positional placement is a separate editorial task.
- Baseline from P4-01: 18 article pages, edition page, text and screenshots.

## Exact steps
1. Ryan yes: run the P4-08 tool with --apply against the new backend (authoring role), then convert-bodies --dry-run, review skips, then --apply.
2. Row-level check: for every copied model compare ids, slugs, titles, status, publishedAt, section, pullQuotes, editorial, layout between old and new (script output).
3. Body check: for each of the 18 PublishedItems, the paragraphs projected from bodyIr equal the old body list exactly.
4. Media check: S3 media/ manifest of the new bucket equals the old (key, size, ETag).
5. Render check: open https://main.<newAppId>.amplifyapp.com; compare edition page and the 18 article pages to the P4-01 baseline (visible text equal; screenshots within the accepted deltas recorded in P4-03); play one video; open /newsroom Articles and see 18 published items plus the 2 doctrine items under their private status.
6. Write the result table into this ticket.

## Acceptance checks
- Row counts per model equal the FACT list; checksums of row JSON (excluding system fields createdAt, updatedAt, owner ids) equal.
- 18 of 18 articles have bodyIr and projected paragraphs equal to the old lists (any skip is listed and resolved or escalated).
- S3 manifest equal; new default URL text-equals the baseline for all 19 public routes.
- Re-running the copy --apply reports zero changes.

## Rollback
New backend only, and it serves nothing public yet: Ryan deletes the new stack and redeploys it empty. The old backend is untouched.

## Risks
Items updated in the old backend between baseline and apply (editors editing): freeze edits in the old /newsroom during P4-08..P4-11 (say so in the ticket).

## Needs Ryan
Yes for the apply (data writes) and the visual sign-off.

## Common rules (Phase 4 Threat Intelligence)
- Plan and facts: the assessment comment on the Phase 4 ticket (PPY-332889). Pattern: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md and docs/standard-site.md 3.2 on origin/develop.
- Ryan: Threat Intelligence is PRE-PRODUCTION; goal is to dogfood the new backend CMS UX before converting anth.us (production). Treat as a hard cutover with brief downtime accepted unless Ryan says otherwise (open question Q1). The OLD app d3on1y5vlrxmam and its backend stay untouched and serving until the retire ticket.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, us-east-1 (SSO is Ryan's). Never print env var or secret VALUES (names only). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally. Creating, changing or deleting AWS resources needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step; deleting data or stacks is done by Ryan or on his explicit yes. Read-only AWS calls are fine.
- NEVER use /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us as a build dir. TI repo work: fresh clone under /Users/home/Projects/ (delete afterwards), feature branch + PR, never push to its main. Papyrus repo: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug>, PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus (the board checkout) only run kbs; never git add or commit there.
- Gherkin first for any Papyrus behavior change (AGENTS.md). Long clear names, no line-level comments.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link and command output when done.
